name: macp_handoff_offer
description: HandoffOffer: proposes transferring responsibility to a target participant (RFC-MACP-0010 Section 4). Sent as message_type HandoffOffer in mode macp.mode.handoff.v1.

handoff_id.description: Identifier of this offer. A new offer after a decline needs a new one.

target_participant.description: The participant offered the responsibility. Only this participant may accept or decline.
